text:
maya: kicking off our quarterly access census for admin/RBAC roles. goal: identify stale admins, KMS key owners we can trim, and svcacct roles we can tighten. plan to run a sweep this week and share findings by friday. any blockers? :wave:

samir: thumbs up. quick Q — do we want the scanner to include both cloud IAM and our internal role-mapping table in vault? last time mismatch popped up.

maya: include both. we'll reconcile by uid/email. if mapping missing, flag for manual review.

lina: FYI: I noticed in KMS audit that a couple keys had cross-project access last month — not sure if that's expected. I'll paste the logs after i run the query.

jordan: re: automation — we can run the iam-census job and output CSV to the shared bucket. suggestion: add a column for "last_active" derived from audit logs so we can prune accounts with no activity >180d.

maya: perfect. add that filter to the job config. owners should get a review ticket for anything flagged as >180d.

samir: i can add the last_active join. quick snippet i used before: ```sql
SELECT acct, role, max(event_timestamp) AS last_active
FROM audit.logs
WHERE resource_type IN ('iam','kms')
GROUP BY acct, role;
```

lina: deploy-bot just posted the latest KMS access report to #infra-artifacts — small sample: key/projects/redwood-prod/crypto-key-01 had 1 external service principal used on 2026-05-02. looks like a batch job.

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/access-census/1839001234/kms-report.csv :white_check_mark:

sec-oncall: for remediation playbook, use runbook "rbac-least-priv-sweep" — steps: 1) notify owner 2) open temporary low-priv role 3) migrate jobs 4) revoke old role. timeline: 7 days for owners to respond before we quarantine.

jordan: can we automate owner lookup? i.e. map service account to recent commit authors and slack workspace owner field. would reduce manual noise.

maya: yes, automatic owner hinting is OK but final decision must be manual. add owner_hint field in report.

samir: also, heads up — the iam-census will detect legacy "admin-all" roles created by kitchen-scripts. we should add a specific filter to prioritize those.

lina: ran quick cross-check: vault->kms bindings mismatch = 3 entries. two are legit (data-team), one is stale. i'll open a ticket for the stale one and assign to @ethan.

maya: assign owners and set deadline 5/14. i'll draft the announcement to owners.

sec-oncall: reminder: enable audit log export for KMS for at least 1yr retention for this sweep. current retention is 90d in some projects. that's insufficient for 180d checks.

samir: ack. infra ticket created to bump retention to 400 days in prod projects. ticket: INF-4721.

jordan: small vuln triage note — rotating keys before owners respond can break integrations. include a dry-run step in the playbook: run rotate-in-sim mode and check job failures in staging.

maya: good catch. added dry-run step.

lina: posting the KMS query I ran for reference: ```bash
gcloud logging read "resource.type=crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign\"" --limit 1000 --format json > kms-usage.json
```

samir: thanks. i'll hook that into the census job. final ask: can we include a small eval of potential business impact for each admin removal? even a 3-level tag (low, medium, high) helps prioritize.

maya: yeah, add impact_hint. use last_active, env (prod/staging), and owner_role to estimate. low/high rules in the doc.

infra-bot: iam-census job scheduled: job-id=iam-census-20260510-01. status=queued.

maya: awesome. i'll post owners list + next steps when job finishes. thanks all. :pray:

sec-oncall: ping if you want the incident channel reserved while we revoke risky admins. can open a temporary channel.

jordan: thanks — will likely use it during remediation window.

maya: end-to-end plan looks good. meeting at 3pm if anyone wants to join the live review.

lina: i'll be there.

samir: me too.

infra-bot: job started: iam-census-20260510-01. progress=0%

deploy-bot: uploaded partial results: s3://redwood-artifacts/access-census/1839001234/partial-1.csv

maya: perfect. updates in thread once final CSV is in.
